  * *Status*: **VERIFIED** (Requires heavy anchoring).

  * *Verbatim Quote*: `"can grow to 70 feet tall, though it stays between 6 to 8 feet in most home environments"`, `"Leaves are gigantic, up to 1 foot or more"`, `"Available Space To Plant: 6-feet-12 feet"`
